proposal.title: Name the amount range clear action
proposal.problem: The amount range popover labels its reset button Clear, without identifying the filter it clears.
proposal.benefit: Screen reader and voice-control users can identify the amount range reset without changing the date filter.

steps.title: Name the amount range clear action
steps.scope: Give the existing clear action an accessible name that identifies the amount range.
acceptance: Users can find the reset as a button named Clear amount range.
Activating the button resets the amount filter and preserves a selected date range.
